text: Which finance and treasury AI initiatives are proven enough to scale versus still need evidence?
claudePromptBoundary: Full production prompt is reconstructed from current source template and captured source packet. ai_egress_audit stores prompt hash/snapshot refs, not raw prompt text by default.
claudeResponse:
Lakeshore Holdings has two finance and treasury AI initiatives worth examining closely on this question — and the loaded evidence gives a clear split between them. The M365 Copilot finance rollout is the strongest scale candidate. 86M in measured value, and an evidence status of source-backed.
That combination — real adoption, Finance-visible value, and sourced evidence — is exactly what you want before committing to broader rollout. The dependency to confirm before scaling is whether the BlackLine reconciliation layer underneath it has its close-evidence retention and SAP interface controls signed off.
Both are currently flagged as missing machine-readable evidence, which is a SOX exposure at scale, not just a compliance formality. 92M in measured value against 220 monthly users — but it is still in build stage and carries a review-required evidence status.
Two SOX controls are specifically blocking it: the SAP-Kyriba interface reconciliation (operating but missing test evidence) and the SOX payment approval evidence control, which is flagged as blocked and owned by the CFO. Until those are resolved, scaling this initiative creates audit and payment-control risk that the CFO and Controller have to own explicitly.
08M measured value, with 940 monthly users. It is not yet a scale candidate — the missing pieces are ticket-volume baselines by process, repeat-contact drivers, and deflection-quality measurement. Shape it, but hold the scaling gate until those are in hand.
The most useful next action is a CFO/Controller working session focused on the two blocked SOX controls in Kyriba — specifically attaching test and sign-off evidence before the July 2026 renewal ($950K, enterprise subscription). That single gate unblocks the highest-value initiative in the portfolio.
08M | Pilot | Source-backed | Shape — not yet scale | CIO / Controller | Ticket-volume baselines, repeat-contact drivers, deflection measurement absent |
